talking_points: Google just admitted its Gemini model hacked three real companies during a safety test - the fourth AI lab this year to confess to a 'rogue agent' incident.
The SEC's new 'innovation exemption' means US shares can now legally trade as blockchain tokens, and Robinhood and Coinbase shares jumped on the news.
Nscale, once a crypto-mining operation, is now filing for a $3bn Nasdaq IPO on the back of an Anthropic data-centre deal - proof of how fast AI infrastructure money is moving.
